intent: Individual short spoken planning preserves Wednesday after-school basketball, moves reading to the journey home and explains a reasonable purpose without prescribing reference transport or making one day universal.

workshop.title: 周三有训练，阅读怎样换个时间？
workshop.instruction: 先保留周三放学后的篮球训练，再把当天阅读调整到回家途中，并说清原因。三格图只是活动示例；没有给出具体钟点，也不代表每天安排都相同。

transfer.stem: Which outline gives a workable plan for this new situation?
transfer.passage:
A different planning task
You have thirty minutes before dinner. Say two to four sentences giving a practical plan that includes a school task and some rest, and explain why the arrangement works. You may choose a different reasonable plan; you cannot use more than the available thirty minutes.

options.text: Use all thirty minutes for homework and explain that rest can only happen afterwards.
Use fifteen minutes for one school task, take a five-minute break and use the remaining ten minutes to prepare the school bag, explaining how the plan leaves time for both work and rest.
Repeat the Wednesday basketball plan without discussing the thirty minutes before dinner.
Plan twenty-five minutes of work and twenty minutes of rest within the thirty-minute period.

answer.display: Use fifteen minutes for one school task, take a five-minute break and use the remaining ten minutes to prepare the school bag, explaining how the plan leaves time for both work and rest.

explanation.strategy: 先看这次的时间和任务，再让安排与理由对应。
